name: fix-user-stakeholder-containment
body: Source: 'Users ⊂ Stakeholders' (deck author ⊂ EY employees; template author ⊂ brand owners). Inconsistency: the graph schema permits `contains` only into requirements.requirement, so user→stakeholder containment cannot be an edge. Resolution: the relationship is recorded in this note; cross-cutting requirements single-binary (ey-employees) and embedded-assets (ey-brand-owner) hang directly off the stakeholders; all others off the users. [autonomous]
